* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 7 January 2022<ref name="img-dookuslightsaber_ai8ba25cd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/dookuslightsaber_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 commit 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/dookuslightsaber_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
